question: The radius of a metallic solid sphere is 21.6 cm. It is melted and drawn into a wire of uniform cross section. If the length of the wire is 259.2 m, then the radius of the wire is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Volume of **Sphere** = Volume of **Wire (Cylinder)**

4/3 × R³ = r² × L

r² = (4 × 21.6 × 21.6 × 21.6) ÷ (3 × 25920) [Note: 259.2 m = 25920 cm]

r² = (21.6 × 21.6) ÷ 900 ⇒ r = 21.6 ÷ 30 = 0.72 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 0.72 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Radius of **metallic solid sphere** (R) = 21.6 cm

Length of **wire** (L) = 259.2 m = 25920 cm

**Formula Used:**

Volume of **Sphere** = 4/3 × π × R³

Volume of **Cylinder (Wire)** = π × r² × L

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bea77b338bb7db4593083c6c9cff621184e4cc6f0c2a8ea8bf81f67bdc682505.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Volume of **sphere** = Volume of **wire**

⇒ 4/3 × π × (21.6)³ = π × r² × 25920

⇒ 4/3 × 21.6 × 21.6 × 21.6 = r² × 25920

⇒ r² = (4 × 21.6 × 21.6 × 21.6) ÷ (3 × 25920)

⇒ r² = (4 × 10077.696) ÷ 77760

⇒ r² = 40310.784 ÷ 77760

⇒ r² = 0.5184

⇒ r = √0.5184

⇒ r = 0.72 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 0.72 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Volume and Surface Area of Sphere

Volume = 4/3 πr³ and Total Surface Area = 4πr².

Volume and Surface Area of Cylinder

Volume = πr²h, Curved Surface Area = 2πrh, and Total Surface Area = 2πr(h + r).

Conversion Factor

1 meter (m) = 100 centimeters (cm). Always ensure all dimensions are in the same unit before calculation.</p
